item.title: I Used to Love Her: An Open Letter
item.description: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass broke my heart. Like my divorce, I knew it was coming but clung to the notion that no one would actually do that to someone who loved them.

item.title: Black-Owned Businesses Join Statewide Shutdown Protesting ICE
item.description: By Damenica Ellis, Minnesota Spokesman-Recorder Black-owned businesses across Minnesota participated in a general strike to protest ICE operations. item.description: At the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics, Sweden is sending a team made up almost exclusively of ethnically Swedish athletes, with NHL player Mika Zibanejad, whose father is from Iran, a rare exception.
